title: Vox-style paper-collage cards
what_it_does: About 110 files of a paper-collage explainer style: serif type, one blue shape per beat, hand-drawn arrows.
when_to_use: Explainer cards; less suited to a talking head.
why: Status is draft in the registry and the look leans on engraving and halftone references that are not shipped; explainer group should judge it, we take the card layouts as ideas.
